messages:
Sven - Oslo Startup: Hey support — trying to redeem onboarding voucher TRIAL500 when upgrading team plan. Checkout errors with "PROMO_NOT_APPLICABLE: tax exceeds voucher value". Billing country: NO, currency NOK. Invoice address Oslo. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/test-sven.png
Maya (Support): Sorry to hear that. Can you paste the exact popup text and confirm billing country + card last4?
Sven - Oslo Startup: Popup: "402 - PROMO_NOT_APPLICABLE: tax exceeds voucher value". Card ends 4242. Promo shows as 500 NOK in email. Tried twice.
Maya (Support): I'll escalate to billing. @Carlos can you take a look? I'll grab logs.
Carlos (Billing): Quick thought — VAT in Norway is 25%. Are we comparing promo to gross or net? If promo is listed as "500 NOK off" but terms say applies to pre-tax, comparing to gross could fail. Need checkout calc logs.
Arun (Backend): Repro'd on eu-staging with acct_01GNOX. Checkout calc (NOK): pre_tax = 400.00; vat = 100.00 (25%); gross = 500.00; promo_value=500.00. PromoEligibility.check(gross) returns false because code uses strict <. Code path compares gross <= promo_value but rounding and semantics mismatch.
Carlos (Billing): Hmm. Promo metadata currently has no apply_to field. Default behavior historically used net. Seems new check uses gross. Also currency rounding in NOK (no minor units) can flip result by 1 kr.
Jen (Payments): UX must remain VAT-inclusive display, but backend can compute eligibility vs net. Also confirm PSP won't object to small adjustments.
Lena (Legal): For Norway, consumer prices must be VAT-inclusive, but nothing prohibits discount application on pre-tax. However promo copy should be explicit. If voucher terms are ambiguous, default to net to avoid disadvantaging customer.
Arun (Backend): Proposed fix: read promo_record.apply_to (enum: "net"|"gross") and if missing, fallback to "net" for EU countries. Also add floor tolerance of 1 (NOK) to account for rounding.
Carlos (Billing): Add unit tests for NOK rounding and for promos with explicit apply_to=gross. Also add data migration to backfill legacy promos as net unless labeled otherwise.
Jen (Payments): Edge case: reverse-charge or B2B cross-border may have 0% VAT — must still work.
Maya (Support): Customer workaround before fix: I can grant a 500 NOK one-time credit to allow upgrade. Would you like that, Sven?
Sven - Oslo Startup: Yes please, that'd unblock us. Thank you.
Arun (Backend): Opening PR with fix & tests: https://git.redwood/r/checkout/PR-842. Canary deploying to eu region.
billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-1293 (Promo eligibility mismatch: gross vs net). Priority P2.
Arun (Backend): Canary smoke: NO account checkout 3/3 passed on canary build.
Maya (Support): Sven — applied 500 NOK credit and triggered upgrade; can you confirm?
Sven - Oslo Startup: Upgrade succeeded. Voucher still visible, credit used. All good.
Carlos (Billing): Postmortem: root cause = ambiguous promo semantics + gross/net mismatch + NOK rounding. Remediation: promo metadata, code fix, docs update, monitoring for 72h.
Maya (Support): Action items: send customer follow-up (done), legal update promo copy, monitor logs. Closing once credits reconciled.
Sven - Oslo Startup: Appreciate the quick help :heart:
